card.name: End of a title-like opening phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a short topic phrase at the very start of a document, right where a title or heading ends and the body text begins. Often a plural noun like programs, noses, projects, or the end of a term.

card.plain: It marks the end of a heading-like opening phrase, where a new paragraph is likely to follow.
